scope: the existing PsField probe is unreliable: it reported index 708 / codec -97, but the address it implies holds zeros

check.memory_at_that_address: four dwords of zeros / 0xFFFFFFFF patterns, no -97 codec
check.conclusion: the probe's assumption that ECX holds the field-table entry pointer at 0x6701D0 entry is WRONG; the register holds something else at that moment

what_the_disassembly_says: the call site (0x6710A2-0x6710BB) computes the entry as [ebp+0x1c] + 12*esi and passes it in ECX
so the table base is the delta decoder's 5th argument ([ebp+0x1c]), which is NOT necessarily 0xDA63E8
the probe should therefore log the TABLE BASE as well (read from the caller frame) or log the raw stack arguments
next: fix the probe: at 0x6701D0 entry log [esp+4], [esp+8], [esp+0xC], [esp+0x10], [esp+0x14] (the five arguments) plus ECX
then the real table base and the real field index become directly observable instead of inferred
